blocks.orig: If your idea of paradise includes ocean breezes, hammock naps, and waking up to waves outside your window, Amani Beach Resort at about 30 kilometres south of Dar es Salaam delivers it with quiet elegance. This property offers several ocean-facing bungalows spaced apart to give each guest a sense of privacy and quiet. The bungalows come with air conditioning, mosquito nets, free Wi-Fi, ensuite bathrooms with showers and private terraces with your own hammock. And when it comes to meals, you can dine at the open-air restaurant or enjoy a drink at the beach bar. The resort also has a swimming pool, beautiful gardens and lawns with shaded paths. Amani means “peace” in Swahili and the lodge totally lives up to its name.
blocks.html: Does your idea of paradise involve sea breezes, naps in a hammock and the sound of waves when you wake up? Then Amani Beach Resort at roughly 30 kilometres south of Dar es Salaam offers exactly that with quiet elegance. The property has several bungalows facing the ocean, set well apart so every guest enjoys privacy and calm. Each bungalow has air conditioning, mosquito nets, free Wi-Fi, an ensuite bathroom with a shower and a private terrace with its own hammock. For meals you can eat at the open-air restaurant or have a drink at the beach bar. There is also a swimming pool, along with lovely gardens and lawns crossed by shady paths. In Swahili, Amani means “peace”, and the lodge lives up to that name completely.
